{
  "name": "Bundle Discounts",
  "description": "Merchants create fixed and flexible product bundles with tiered discounts; customers select items on product pages and add them to cart with discount auto-applied.",
  "database": {
    "tables": [
      {
        "name": "bundles",
        "purpose": "Stores each bundle's identity, mode (fixed or flexible), enabled state, and a system-managed health status reflecting variant availability.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",            "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()", "purpose": "internal bundle id" },
          { "name": "title",         "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "description",   "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NULL" },
          { "name": "mode",          "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'flexible'", "enum": ["fixed", "flexible"], "purpose": "fixed bundles have a predefined set; flexible bundles let customers pick from a pool" },
          { "name": "enabled",       "sqlType": "BOOLEAN",     "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT false" },
          { "name": "health_status", "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'healthy'", "enum": ["healthy", "warned", "auto_disabled"], "purpose": "merchant-facing health signal driven by variant availability changes" },
          { "name": "created_at",    "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" },
          { "name": "updated_at",    "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": [],
        "indexes": [["enabled", "created_at"], ["health_status"], ["created_at"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_items",
        "purpose": "Stores the variant-level products belonging to each bundle, including the last-observed availability of each variant.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",                   "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()" },
          { "name": "bundle_id",            "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle this item belongs to" },
          { "name": "variant_external_id",  "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "Shopify variant ID" },
          { "name": "product_external_id",  "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "Shopify product ID, used for deletion event matching" },
          { "name": "observed_availability","sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available'", "enum": ["available", "out_of_stock", "deleted"], "purpose": "last known availability state" },
          { "name": "added_at",             "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["bundle_id", "variant_external_id"],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "added_at"], ["variant_external_id"], ["bundle_id", "observed_availability"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_tiers",
        "purpose": "Stores each discount tier for a bundle, including minimum item count and discount rate, ordered by merchant-defined display sequence.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",                 "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()" },
          { "name": "bundle_id",          "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle this tier belongs to" },
          { "name": "minimum_item_count", "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "discount_rate",      "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "discount percentage as integer (e.g. 10 = 10%)" },
          { "name": "display_order",      "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "created_at",         "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" },
          { "name": "updated_at",         "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["bundle_id", "minimum_item_count"],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "display_order"], ["bundle_id", "minimum_item_count"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_purchase_records",
        "purpose": "Records every bundle present in a paid order, keyed by order external id and bundle id for idempotency.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",                    "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()" },
          { "name": "bundle_id",             "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle that was purchased" },
          { "name": "order_external_id",     "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "Shopify order ID" },
          { "name": "order_placed_at",       "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "variant_external_ids",  "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "JSON-serialized array of Shopify variant IDs selected at purchase time" },
          { "name": "item_count",            "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "discount_rate_applied", "sqlType": "INTEGER",     "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "integer percentage applied (e.g. 10 = 10%)" },
          { "name": "order_total",           "sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "order total in minor currency units" },
          { "name": "order_currency",        "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL", "purpose": "ISO currency code" },
          { "name": "recorded_at",           "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": ["order_external_id", "bundle_id"],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "order_placed_at"], ["order_placed_at"], ["order_external_id"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      },
      {
        "name": "bundle_health_events",
        "purpose": "Logs every automated health change applied to a bundle so merchants can audit why a bundle changed state.",
        "columns": [
          { "name": "id",                          "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()" },
          { "name": "bundle_id",                   "sqlType": "UUID",        "constraints": "NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE", "purpose": "the bundle whose health changed" },
          { "name": "event_kind",                  "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL", "enum": ["auto_disabled", "warned", "cleared"], "purpose": "type of health change" },
          { "name": "affected_variant_external_id","sqlType": "BIGINT",      "constraints": "NULL", "purpose": "the variant whose availability triggered this health change" },
          { "name": "reason",                      "sqlType": "TEXT",        "constraints": "NOT NULL" },
          { "name": "occurred_at",                 "sqlType": "TIMESTAMPTZ", "constraints": "NOT NULL DEFAULT now()" }
        ],
        "uniqueConstraint": [],
        "indexes": [["bundle_id", "occurred_at"]],
        "foreignKeys": []
      }
    ]
  },
  "shopifyIntegration": {
    "webhookTopics": [
      "orders/paid",
      "inventory_levels/update",
      "products/delete"
    ],
    "cronSchedule": null
  },
  "httpRoutes": {
    "admin": [
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/bundles",              "handler": "listBundles",       "description": "Paginated list of bundles with mode, status, tier count" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/create",       "handler": "createBundle",      "description": "Create a new bundle in disabled state" },
      { "method": "PUT",  "path": "/admin/bundles/update",       "handler": "updateBundle",      "description": "Update bundle title, description, mode, or enabled flag" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/remove",       "handler": "removeBundle",      "description": "Delete a bundle and cascade-remove items and tiers" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/clone",        "handler": "cloneBundle",       "description": "Duplicate a bundle with all items and tiers" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/bulk-status",  "handler": "bulkSetBundleStatus", "description": "Enable or disable a set of bundles" },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/bundles/items",        "handler": "listBundleItems",   "description": "Paginated list of variant items for a bundle" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/items/save",   "handler": "saveBundleItems",   "description": "Replace the full item set for a bundle" },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/bundles/tiers",        "handler": "listBundleTiers",   "description": "All discount tiers for a bundle in display order" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/admin/bundles/tiers/save",   "handler": "saveBundleTiers",   "description": "Replace the full tier list for a bundle" },
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/admin/purchase-history",     "handler": "listPurchaseHistory", "description": "Paginated purchase history log" }
    ],
    "widget": [
      { "method": "GET",  "path": "/widget/bundle",          "handler": "getBundleForWidget",  "description": "Bundle config, tiers, and item availability for widget render" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/widget/bundle/validate", "handler": "validateBundleSelection", "description": "Validate customer selection and return earned tier" },
      { "method": "POST", "path": "/widget/cart/add",        "handler": "addBundleToCart",     "description": "Add validated bundle selection to cart with discount" }
    ]
  }
}
